title: pairtime doctor --json
description: The checks `pairtime doctor` prints, one per line of its text, as `pairtime doctor --json` prints them (docs/PLAN.md WP-AG6; DESIGN 5.9). Each check has a name, a result and the text its line shows: what doctor found and, when something is wrong, the one thing to do about it. The idle, focus, adapter, ledger and spool checks read the running agent's status (GET /v1/status, which doctor asks over the agent's socket), never the terminal doctor runs in; with no agent to ask they are skipped. The other checks read this computer: each installed harness's hooks and a test call of them, the keystore, the binary's signature. Then comes one check for each problem the agent reports, in its words. doctor exits 1 when a check failed. cmd/pairtime's tests check `pairtime doctor --json` against this file.

name.description: What was checked: agent, idle, focus, macos-loop, hook.<harness>, trust.<harness>, adapter.<harness>, adapter.other, ledger, signing, keystore, spool, or problem.<source> for a problem the agent reports, such as problem.uploader.

result.description: ok: it works. warn: it works, with something to know, or that costs some of your time until it's fixed. fail: it doesn't work, and pairtime misses time until it does. skip: doctor couldn't check it, and text says why.

summary.description: How many checks had each result.
